column1: # Mutants for job-013: the exact-fill fix, for real this time.
# Python 1.1.6 moved the trailing-page pop AFTER the per-page blank-stripping, which is the
# whole fix — the pop was always there, it just ran too early to see the page it was written
# for. So the mutants here are almost entirely ABOUT POSITION, and the headline row is the
# inverse of job-012's: what was staged there as "the fix Athena should ship" is now the
# source, and 1.1.5's position is now the mutant.
# Run:  Scripts/mutate.sh Scripts/mutants/job-013.tsv
# THE regression mutant: put the pop back where 1.1.5 had it. Expressed as a single-site
# edit — pop, then strip, then return early — which is exactly 1.1.5's order and leaves the
# real pop below as dead code. Anchoring the move as one contiguous region would have meant
# swallowing eleven lines of comment between the two sites; this says the same thing about
# behavior and stays readable.
# If this survives, the suite cannot tell 1.1.6 from 1.1.5 and job-013 proved nothing.
layout-pop-before-stripping
# Delete the pop outright. Also in job-012.tsv (where it was a real survivor until
# trailingDoublePageBreakDoesNotLeaveABlankSheet was written); kept live here because the
# 1.1.6 position gives it two reachable cases instead of one, and both should be caught.
layout-no-trailing-page-pop
# Pop at most one page, not all trailing empties. Reachable with three trailing .pa.
layout-pop-once-not-while
# Strip trailing blank lines but not leading ones, and vice versa — the stripping half of
# the fix has to keep working for the pop to have anything to find.
layout-no-trailing-blank-strip
